deck-review · skill for claude code · v1.0

Annotate it, send it back.

A localhost review UI for any Edmund deck or document. Click to pin a comment, drag a box over a chart, or select text to quote it exactly. Hit send and Claude Code wakes up with your comments and applies them to the source.

The real thing. Badge 1 is a pin, badge 2 quotes the exact sentence it is attached to.

HOW IT WORKSNothing to poll, nothing to paste

The server blocks while you annotate. Sending writes a JSON file and exits, and that exit is what re-invokes Claude Code. The deck file on disk is never modified, so whatever you print to PDF stays clean.

INSTALLTwo ways in

Pick by whether you want updates. The plugin route pulls new versions with one command. The upload route is three clicks and no GitHub, but you re-upload to update.

Route A · updates itself

Install as a plugin

/plugin marketplace add ladislav-sv/deck-review
/plugin install deck-review@edmund

Later, to get the newest version:

/plugin update deck-review@edmund
Route B · no GitHub

Upload the skill

Three clicks in Claude’s own settings, described below. Nothing to download except one small zip, and it follows your Claude account onto any Mac you sign into.

Route B, step by step

Open Claude’s settings

Press ⌘,, then click Skills under Customize in the left column.

The list you land on is every skill on your Claude account. Uploading puts deck-review alongside them, and Claude downloads it to your Mac so it can actually run.

Drawn from the real menu, not a screenshot.

Add → Upload a skill

The Add button is top right. Choose Upload a skill and pick deck-review-skill.zip. That is the whole install.

Ask for it

No command to memorise. Type what you actually want:

let me annotate the onboarding docs
Why this works

An uploaded skill is not stuck in the cloud. Claude copies it down to your Mac and runs its bundled script there, which is what lets deck-review open a page in your browser and read your files. Anthropic’s own skills work the same way.

IF YOU LIKE TERMINALSThe plugin route

The unzipped folder is also a Claude Code plugin marketplace, which keeps it updatable and removable like any other plugin. Two commands inside Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add ~/Downloads/deck-review
/plugin install deck-review@edmund

Or skip the plugin machinery and just copy the files in:

bash ~/Downloads/deck-review/install.sh
Not the chat app

The Claude Desktop chat assistant cannot run this. Skills uploaded there execute in Anthropic's sandbox, not on your Mac, so they cannot serve 127.0.0.1 to your browser or read your Downloads folder. This tool needs both. It has to be installed into Claude Code, which includes Claude Code running inside the Desktop app.

DECKS AND DOCSIt picks the mode from the page

 Deck modeDoc mode
Triggered bythe page has slidesanything else
Layoutslides scaled to fit the windowthe document keeps its own layout
A comment is anchored tothe slide, numbered to match the printed page the nearest block: a section, a heading, a paragraph, a table
Reads back asS07 · text#keystatic · text

Document comments also carry the nearest preceding heading, so Claude knows where it is in words and not just in pixels. Coordinates are relative to the block rather than the page, which means they still point at the right thing after the document reflows.

USING ITThree ways to leave a comment

Click

Pin

Drops a numbered dot. Good for "something is off here" when the words are not the problem.

Drag a blank area

Box a region

Claude crops the rendered page to your rectangle and actually looks at it before changing anything.

Select text

Quote it

Captures the exact words. The most precise of the three, because the string can be found in the source.

Hold ⇧ while dragging to force a box over text. ⌘↵ saves a comment, esc cancels. Comments survive a page refresh, and the rail shows a green SERVER LIVE dot while the round trip is available.

RUNNING IT YOURSELFThe command, if you want it

python3 ~/.claude/skills/deck-review/review_server.py deck.html

--port 7654     starting port, auto-increments if taken
--timeout 3600  seconds to wait before giving up
--no-open       do not open a browser
--out PATH      explicit output json path

WHEN IT MISBEHAVESThe three things that actually go wrong

SymptomWhat it is
Send does nothingThe server stopped. The rail turns orange and says SERVER OFFLINE within four seconds. Your comments are still in the tab: use Copy JSON to clipboard and paste it into the chat, or ask Claude to reopen the review and reload the page.
Port already in useIt walks up from 7654 to the first free port and prints the real URL on startup. Use the printed one.
Comments land on the whole documentDoc mode anchors to headings and sections. A page that is one unbroken blob has nothing to anchor to, so comments attach to the root. Selecting text still pins them exactly.
Careful

If the deck has a sibling *_build.py, that script is the source of truth. Comments must be applied there, not to the generated HTML, or the next build silently reverts them.

Note

The browser collapses whitespace, so a quoted sentence that wraps across two lines in the source comes back as one line. Match on a short fragment, never the whole sentence.

WHAT IS IN THE ZIPA marketplace of one

PathRole
.claude-plugin/marketplace.jsonMakes the folder installable with /plugin marketplace add.
plugins/deck-review/The plugin, with its own plugin.json.
  skills/deck-review/review_server.pyThe server and the injected overlay. The whole tool.
  skills/deck-review/SKILL.mdTells Claude when to reach for it and how to apply what comes back.
install.shThe no-plugin route: copies the two files into ~/.claude/skills/deck-review/.
